comment: Frozen mathematical assumptions (plan.md §4). Math layer is assumed, not proven. 11 kernel-level declarations = 10 source sorries (elligator def yields two proof obligations). G2 requires: the set of Math declarations whose own body mentions sorryAx equals exactly this list, with identical statement hashes.

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.inv_sqrt_checked_spec
assumptions.statement: ∀ (arg : ZMod p) {I : ZMod p} {was_square : Bool},  curve25519_dalek.math.inv_sqrt_checked arg = (I, was_square) → was_square = true → arg ≠ 0 → I ^ 2 * arg = 1

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.inv_sqrt_checked_sq_mul
assumptions.statement: ∀ (u : ZMod p), IsSquare u → u ≠ 0 → (curve25519_dalek.math.inv_sqrt_checked u).1 ^ 2 * u = 1

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.sqrt_checked_iff_isSquare
assumptions.statement: ∀ (u : ZMod p) {r : ZMod p} {b : Bool}, curve25519_dalek.math.sqrt_checked u = (r, b) → (b = true ↔ IsSquare u)

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.sqrt_checked_spec
assumptions.statement: ∀ (u : ZMod p) {r : ZMod p} {b : Bool}, curve25519_dalek.math.sqrt_checked u = (r, b) → b = true → r ^ 2 = u

assumptions.name: Edwards.add_assoc_Ed25519
assumptions.statement: ∀ (p q r : Edwards.Point Edwards.Ed25519), p + q + r = p + (q + r)

assumptions.name: Edwards.complete_addition_denominators_ne_zero
assumptions.statement: ∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [NeZero 2] (C : Edwards.EdwardsCurve F),  IsSquare C.a →   ¬IsSquare C.d →    ∀ (p1 p2 : Edwards.Point C),     have lam := C.d * p1.x * p2.x * p1.y * p2.y;     1 + lam ≠ 0 ∧ 1 - lam ≠ 0

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.decompress_edwards_pure._proof_6
assumptions.statement: ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Array Aeneas.Std.U8 32#usize)  (h : IsSquare ((↑(U8x32_as_Nat bytes % 2 ^ 255) ^ 2 - 1) * (↑d * ↑(U8x32_as_Nat bytes % 2 ^ 255) ^ 2 + 1)⁻¹)),  Edwards.Ed25519.a *     (if        (curve25519_dalek.math.is_negative (curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)) !=          (U8x32_as_Nat bytes / 2 ^ 255 == 1)) =         true then       -curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)      else curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)) ^      2 +    ↑(U8x32_as_Nat bytes % 2 ^ 255) ^ 2 =   1 +    Edwards.Ed25519.d *      (if         (curve25519_dalek.math.is_negative (curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)) !=           (U8x32_as_Nat bytes / 2 ^ 255 == 1)) =          true then        -curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)       else curve25519_dalek.math.abs_edwards (Classical.choose h)) ^       2 *     ↑(U8x32_as_Nat bytes % 2 ^ 255) ^ 2

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_pure._proof_1
assumptions.statement: ∀ (r0 : ZMod p),  Edwards.Ed25519.a * curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_x r0 ^ 2 +    curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_y r0 ^ 2 =   1 +    Edwards.Ed25519.d * curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_x r0 ^ 2 *     curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_y r0 ^ 2

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_pure._proof_2
assumptions.statement: ∀ (r0 : ZMod p),  curve25519_dalek.ristretto.IsEven   { x := curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_x r0,    y := curve25519_dalek.math.elligator_ristretto_flavor_y r0, on_curve := ⋯ }

assumptions.name: curve25519_dalek.ristretto.IsEven_iff_in_doubling_image_right
assumptions.statement: ∀ (P : Edwards.Point Edwards.Ed25519), curve25519_dalek.ristretto.IsEven P → ∃ Q, P = Q + Q
